title: Ultimate Mortal Kombat 3
overview: The Ultimate conversion of the Ultimate Coin-op! 22 playable characters from the Mortal Kombat Hall of fame, 4 new dynamic fighting arenas, and revolutionary Special Moves, Combos, Fatalities, Babalities, and Animalities combine to make this the essential beat 'em up on Sega Saturn. The Ultimate Fight For Your Life Kontinues.
